module_summary: 32-bit XGMII-to-AXI-stream receiver: input words pass a 3-stage delay pipeline while start/terminate/error control characters are detected, a 4-state FSM frames packets and an LFSR CRC32 child checks FCS per terminate lane.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/PREAMBLE/PAYLOAD/LAST controller framing packets and FCS checks

anchors.name: xgmii_rxd_d0
anchors.why: First data delay stage with control bytes zeroed; feeds CRC child

anchors.name: xgmii_rxd_d2
anchors.why: Final data delay stage aligned with CRC result, sent to output

anchors.name: xgmii_start_d2
anchors.why: Delayed start-character detect triggering packet reception from IDLE

anchors.name: term_present_reg
anchors.why: Terminate character detected in word; ends payload state

anchors.name: term_lane_reg
anchors.why: Lane of terminate character selecting tkeep and CRC check variant

anchors.name: framing_error_reg
anchors.why: Unexpected control characters flag forcing bad-frame termination

anchors.name: crc_state
anchors.why: Running CRC32 state fed to LFSR child, reset between frames

anchors.name: crc_next
anchors.why: LFSR next CRC compared to residue constants per lane

anchors.name: crc_valid_save
anchors.why: Registered per-lane CRC match flags deciding bad FCS at frame end

anchors.name: xgmii_rxd
anchors.why: XGMII receive data word

anchors.name: xgmii_rxc
anchors.why: XGMII per-lane control flags used for start/terminate detection

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output AXI-stream payload word

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output beat valid from m_axis_tvalid_reg

anchors.name: m_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Output end-of-frame marker

anchors.name: m_axis_tkeep
anchors.why: Byte enables for final partial word

anchors.name: m_axis_tuser
anchors.why: Bad-frame flag and optional PTP timestamp sideband

anchors.name: cfg_rx_enable
anchors.why: Configuration enable gating packet acceptance in IDLE

anchors.name: start_packet
anchors.why: Pulse indicating start of received packet

anchors.name: error_bad_frame
anchors.why: Pulse reporting framing error or bad frame

anchors.name: error_bad_fcs
anchors.why: Pulse reporting FCS mismatch

groups.name: Receive framing FSM
groups.description: Detects start/terminate/error characters and sequences packet framing

groups.name: Input delay pipeline
groups.description: Three-stage XGMII data delay aligning output with CRC result

groups.name: CRC check
groups.description: LFSR CRC32 with per-lane residue comparison flags

groups.name: Status outputs
groups.description: Configuration enable and packet/error status pulses
